parts:
Hi
  I haven't done much on this in R but it seems to me that Shiny offers a great opportunity in this area
A recent post referred to creating HTML for 3D plots and from a v brief look the plotGoogleMaps package
might have a similar solution but most of the mapping packages seem to be into producing, typically png files

If I was using say, the RgoogleMaps package and in the simplest case had a lat and long input for use
in it's GetMap function which normally rights to a named destfile how would I go about applying it in server.R?
Can I use this to write to a file and then immediately view it. I have used the png package to display a bitmap file
in shiny viz

output$Plot <- reactivePlot(function() {
    
   # possible to retrieve map in file
    img <- readPNG("map.png")
    grid::grid.raster(img) 
})

Presumably there would also need to be a way to delete these files to stop them accummulating
